# Which parts of CI a pull request has to run, decided from the files it changes
# (read by .github/scripts/changed-areas.py through .github/workflows/changes.yml).
#
# One rule per line:  <kind> <glob>
#   The glob is matched against the repository-relative path with fnmatch, where
#   `*` also matches `/` (so `docs/*` is everything below docs/).
#
# Kinds:
#   ignore   the file needs no CI at all (documentation, repository metadata)
#   all      everything runs (the CI itself changed)
#   rust     the Rust workspace: cargo test, Clippy, rustdoc, cross-platform tests,
#            the Rust CodeQL analysis
#   cpp      the C++ build and tests on Linux, Windows and macOS (+ the toolchain image)
#   format   the rustfmt / clang-format check
#   ffi      the mobile and window-system jobs of rust.yml (they check the `ffi`
#            crate and everything it depends on)
#
# A changed file may match several kinds. A file that matches NO rule at all (a
# new top-level directory, an unknown file) makes everything run: a gap in this
# list can only cost time, never hide a failure. Pushes to main/develop, the
# nightly run and manual runs ignore this file and run everything.
#
# Not listed here on purpose: the crates `ffi` depends on. They are worked out
# from the Cargo.toml files on every run (see changed-areas.py), so adding a
# dependency to `ffi` needs no edit here.

# ---- nothing to run -------------------------------------------------------
ignore docs/*
ignore *.md
ignore LICENSE
ignore assets/*
ignore book.toml
ignore .github/CODEOWNERS
ignore .github/FUNDING.yml
ignore .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*
ignore .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE*
ignore .github/dependabot.yml
# Workflows that are not part of ci.yml's graph.
ignore .github/workflows/stale.yml
ignore .github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml
ignore .github/workflows/deploy.yml
ignore .github/workflows/benchmarks.yml
ignore .github/workflows/dependency-review.yml
ignore .github/workflows/bootstrap-smoke.yml

# ---- how CI itself runs: everything ----------------------------------------
all .github/workflows/*
all .github/actions/*
all .github/scripts/*
all .github/ci-areas.txt

# ---- Rust -------------------------------------------------------------------
rust engine/rust/*
rust tools/*
rust tests/rust/*
rust tests/common/*
rust tests/math_golden/*
rust benchmarks/*
rust fuzz/*
rust templates/*
rust Cargo.toml
rust Cargo.lock
rust rust-toolchain
rust rust-toolchain.toml
rust .cargo/*
rust clippy.toml
rust .clippy.toml
rust rustfmt.toml
rust .rustfmt.toml
rust deny.toml

# ---- C++ (plus the Rust crates ffi depends on, added automatically) ----------
cpp engine/cpp/*
cpp tests/cpp/*
cpp tests/math_golden/*
cpp test_assets/*
cpp CMakeLists.txt
cpp CMakePresets.json
cpp cmake/*
cpp vcpkg.json
cpp vcpkg-configuration.json
cpp third_party/*
cpp .clang-tidy
cpp devkit/ci/*
cpp devkit/scripts/setup/*
cpp devkit/scripts/configure-windows.ps1
# The workspace files decide how the Rust staticlib that C++ links is built.
cpp Cargo.toml
cpp Cargo.lock
cpp rust-toolchain
cpp rust-toolchain.toml
cpp .cargo/*

# ---- formatting ---------------------------------------------------------------
format engine/*
format tools/*
format tests/*
format .clang-format
format .editorconfig
format rustfmt.toml
format .rustfmt.toml
format Cargo.toml
format devkit/scripts/setup/config/tool-versions.json

# ---- mobile / window-system jobs ------------------------------------------------
ffi Cargo.toml
ffi Cargo.lock
ffi rust-toolchain
ffi rust-toolchain.toml
ffi .cargo/*
